item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 23/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring showers to the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, showers are expected to ease off gradually over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend and early next week. The area of low pressure now over the seas east of Luzon may develop gradually in the latter part of this week to early next week. It might then have a chance to affect the vicinity of the coast of southern China and Taiwan, but its movement would remain uncertain.
